a: A [Trash] effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash.
Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: When I play a [Sistermon Ciel], in what order can I activate that Digimon's [On Play] effect and this card's [Trash] [All Turns] effect?
When I play a [Sistermon Ciel], can I activate this card's [Trash] [All Turns] effect first, digivolve that Digimon into this card, then activate the [On Play] effect on the played [Sistermon Ciel]?

Effect: [Trash] [All Turns] When any of your Digimon are played, 1 of your [Sistermon Ciel]s may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until the end of their turn.
[End of All Turns] Place this Digimon's top stacked card as the top security card.
